text: This solution, Coastal Protection Concepts for Greater Southern Waterfront (GSW) and Changi — City–East Coast Site‑Specific Study (SSS) addresses natural catastrophe in Singapore between PUB, Singapore’s National Water Agency, Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA), Singapore Land Authority (SLA), Land Transport Authority (LTA), and National Climate Change Secretariat (NCCS). The program was implemented in 2021 and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
